subject: VAT certificate acceptance & invoice redraft to release payment hold
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Payment hold: SolaceHealth invoice 4821 - VAT ID check failed

Vanessa —

Finance put invoice #4821 on hold after SolaceHealth's VAT number failed the VIES lookup (response: invalid). AP is asking for either a valid EU VAT certificate or a company registration extract showing the VAT assignment. They uploaded a PDF to the portal earlier this morning (attached as "solace_vat_certificate.pdf") but Ops flagged a mismatch between the VAT number on the certificate and the one on the PO.

Quick context: this is an annual usage invoice for Q3 services (RDW-DEAL-4821). Jordan has been negotiating net terms with them; they said they'd route payment once the hold is lifted.

Can you advise if we should:
- request the Handelsregister extract and original VAT certificate notarized, OR
- accept the uploaded PDF and reissue the invoice under reverse-charge (no VAT) so AP can pay?

Ben — FYI for collections cadence; if we release, do we need the customer's signed MA POC?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: solace_vat_certificate.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Payment hold: SolaceHealth invoice 4821 - VAT ID check failed

Thanks Neha — forwarding to Jordan and Markus for tax/legal sign-off.

Jordan: can you ask SolaceHealth to provide the company extract (Handelsregister) and confirm the VAT number in the portal is the one they expect us to use? If they can attach both documents, that should speed review.

Markus: tagging you for confirmation — if the certificate + Handelsregister match, are we comfortable with redrafting the invoice without VAT (reverse-charge) and releasing to AP? If you prefer, we can request an original-signed PDF, but AP is pushing us for a same-week payment.

If legal signs off, Ben please reissue the invoice (no VAT) and mark payment as cleared pending transfer.

— Vanessa
Head of Account Management
Redwood Inference

From: Sven Müller <sven.mueller@solacehealth.de>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@solacehealth.de
Date: 2026-11-01T11:30:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Payment hold - invoice 4821 (VAT docs attached)

Hi Vanessa / Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. Attached are two documents: the official EU VAT registration certificate and an extract from the Handelsregister confirming our legal name and VAT assignment (files: "solace_vat_certificate.pdf", "company_extract.pdf"). The VAT number on both documents matches the one on our PO (ending in 7321) — not sure why VIES returned invalid earlier, likely a propagation delay.

AP would prefer we receive an invoice without VAT and a short note referencing the reverse-charge (Article 196) so payment can be processed under their local rules. If you can reissue today, we will release payment within 48 hours.

Regards,
Sven Müller
Head of Finance — SolaceHealth GmbH

Attachments: solace_vat_certificate.pdf (pdf, 120KB), company_extract.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Payment hold - invoice 4821 (VAT docs attached)

I reviewed the attached documents. Summary:
- The VAT certificate and Handelsregister extract match the entity name and VAT number shown on the PO and the portal.
- VIES sometimes returns false negatives during maintenance; the local documents are governing evidence.

Required next steps for compliance and audit trail:
1) Redraft invoice #4821 with: customer VAT number, buyer & supplier addresses, explicit reverse-charge language (e.g., "Tax due by recipient — Article 196 VAT Directive"), and zero VAT line.
2) Attach the uploaded VAT certificate and company extract to the invoice record and keep scanned copies for 10 years.
3) Finance to note the journal entry reference and tag the transaction as "RC-EU" in our ledger.

From a legal/tax perspective I am comfortable accepting the portal files as valid evidence and approving the reverse-charge treatment. Please proceed once Ben confirms reissue.

-Markus
Senior Counsel (Tax)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Reissue: invoice 4821 (redraft completed)

All —

I've redrafted invoice #4821 and removed the VAT line as requested. New invoice file attached: "redrafted_invoice_4821_no_vat.pdf". The invoice includes: customer VAT number, seller & buyer addresses, the reverse-charge reference (Article 196), and ledger tag RC-EU. We updated the invoice record in the billing portal: https://redwood.app/invoice/4821 (see related link).

Action items:
- Vanessa / Jordan: please confirm you want me to release the hold and send the invoice to accounts-payable@solacehealth.de.
- Finance will mark the payment as "pending" until funds are received; expected posting within 48 hours of AP release.

Ben Carter

Appreciate the quick turnaround from everyone.
